purpose: Countdown 倒计时; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandCountdown](../../lib/src/components/countdown.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Derive remaining time from deadline, never accumulate timer drift; finish once per deadline, cancel on disposal. Reminders and shake compare thresholds with the displayed, rounded-up seconds. Reminders: the smallest matching threshold wins (first on ties), none by default; IslandCountdownReminder.defaults is the reference 60s orange / 10s red set. Shake (null by default) runs while 0 < displayed seconds <= threshold and escalates at or below urgentThreshold; a new deadline outside the range stops it at rest. The shake ticker runs only while shaking with motion enabled and is muted by TickerMode.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints. NumberSurface owns only the shared outer decoration; NumberPlate owns the inner numeric plate. The component owns its time model, callbacks, semantics and opaque slots; explicit child styles win.
interface.accessibility: The digit group is one semantics node whose value is the displayed time and whose label is semanticLabel (the reference aria-label on the role=timer root); the digit glyphs are excluded. Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. Reduced motion settles digit timeline and endpoints. Bordered digit plates use a1.5px border; colon literals keep weight900 at the digit size (lifted .08em) and other literal separators use weight700 at the body size (reference .sep). Re-enabling motion cannot resume a prior transition. Owned readable text roles also set default icon roles. Fixed light content surfaces scope light semantic roles for nested public controls; explicit child styles and unrelated ThemeExtensions remain unchanged. Dashed strokes use the single public foundation painter under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke. This component retains its existing shape, color, width, dash/gap, state and content ownership; no second contour loop or consumer-private import. The surface is CSS fit-content: it hugs its single run and, once the content wraps, takes the full available width with centred runs. Digits, colon and literal separators use the reference #8b7355 deepened in hue to #836b4e (NumberColors.digits, the Time clock ink; 4.5:1 on the plates and both surfaces, docs/DESIGN.md#measured-color-differences). A reminder colours digits, colon and literal separators with a 200ms motion-ease transition (immediate under reduced motion) and, when bordered, the plate border at once; the prefix and surface keep their colours. The shake moves only the digit group about its centre: each period bursts over its first 30% (keyframes 0/6/12/18/24/30%: 0, -d, +d, -d, +d, 0 with the same sign of rotation, each segment eased by the shake curve) and rests 70%; defaults 1000ms, 1.5px, 0.6deg, urgent 650ms, 2.5px, 0.9deg, curve Cubic(.4,0,.2,1). Reduced motion removes the shake; colours stay. Rolling digits keep their own timeline.
interface.migration: Fresh implementation; no old-library compatibility track.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.given: The existing dashed recipe in each supported size, applicable state and target pixel ratio, with opaque content
scenarios.when: Render and update the same component, including its current hover/press/focus and stroke-width recipes where applicable
scenarios.then: The contour, final short dash and inset match the unchanged recipe; all drawing uses the shared public foundation mechanism. Content geometry, callback/focus behavior and lifecycle remain unchanged under docs/API.md#dashed-stroke.

scenarios.given: Default, custom and empty reminders, default and custom shake, bordered and unbordered plates, with and without reduced motion
scenarios.when: The displayed seconds cross 61→60, 11→10, 6→5, 4→3 and 1→0, and the deadline is reset outside the range
scenarios.then: Colours change exactly at the displayed thresholds with the smallest matching rule; the digit group shakes with the burst geometry only inside the shake range and escalates at the urgent threshold; nothing moves under reduced motion or at zero; finish still fires once.
